description.p: Includes emulators for the HP 35, HP 80, HP 45, HP 70, HP 55, HP 21, HP 22, HP 25, HP 25C, HP 27, HP 29C, HP 31E, HP 32E, HP 33E, HP 33C, HP 34C, HP 37E, HP 38C, HP 38E, HP10, HP 67, HP 10C, HP 11C, HP 12C, HP 15C, and HP 16C.

If GTK is available then on models with continuous memory or a card reader, right-clicking on the application window will open a dialog window allowing the user to load a saved program in 'run' mode or save it in 'prgm' mode.

The default model can be changed either by right-clicking on desktop icon, or if this isn't supported on your system you can access the configuration dialog from a terminal window using the command flatpak run io.github.mike632t.x11-calc --setup

p.em: Note - The following fonts should be installed xfonts-base (Debian/Ubuntu), xorg-x11-fonts-base or xorg-x11-fonts-misc (Fedora), font-misc-misc (Gentoo).

description.p: Improvements to the user interface to allow users to resize the window and copy contents of the display using Ctrl-C
Fixed bug that caused the geometry to be ignored if value was zero
Updated and improved HP67
Implemented HP67 card reader
Added HP55
Implemented file selection dialog using GTK
Users without a NumLock key can now enable the numeric keypad using the --numlock' option
Improved display updates
Added HP10
Fixed regression bug that affected HP12C
Added support for European display formats for SPICE series
Fixed storage overflow error display
Updated release meta data
Application now sets the icon
Another bug fix and addition of shortcut keys for 'A-E' on 15C and 11C
Minor bug fix
Firmware support and zooming enhancements

ul.li: Allow to increase calculator size with --zoom [0-4] parameter
Embed missing firmware (separate ROM files no longer required)

description.p: Improve flathub layout, icon and shortcuts
Initial release
